frequency_question: What proportion of major GST statutory/procedural amendments are fully drafted, vetted, and gazetted within a 131-day operational window from initial technical consensus?
membership_rule: Includes all formal notifications or Act amendments altering core tax credit eligibility or structural tax provisions under the GST framework; excludes minor procedural clarifications, rate adjustments, and circulars.

cases.name: GST Amendment Act 2023 (online gaming and tribunal framework)
Emergency Rate Rationalization Notifications (typical fast-track cycle)

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 major structural amendment cycles examined; all successfully completed within windows once prioritized, but minimum technical process inherently requires ~90 to 120 days.
known_gaps: Excludes minor state-level variations and non-gazetted circulars.
skeleton: Standard bureaucratic timeline: Drafting (30 days) + Legal Vetting/Law Ministry review (30 days) + GST Council Secretariat finalization (30 days) + Gazette Notification (15 days) = 105 days total minimum sequential critical path.
validity_reason: Legislative drafting procedures, bureaucratic hierarchies, and statutory gazette publication timelines in the Indian central government remain stable across decades.
